We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string? Actually function signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). Then we can analyze peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm, integration of 3H each. But we only have textual spectrum, maybe includes integration values. We need to parse.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
